summary: @ornikar/intl-config preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package's `preinstall` script runs an obfuscated `setup.mjs` (rotated string-array, `_0xNNNN` identifiers) that downloads the Bun runtime archive from `github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases`, extracts the `bun` binary to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and uses it to execute a sibling `math_init.js` file via `execFileSync(bunPath, [math_init.js])`. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB single-line, heavily obfuscated JavaScript bundle (obfuscator.io fingerprints: string-array rotator, `_0x...` identifiers, large opaque string/number pools) that is not referenced or required by any of the package's documented i18n helpers (`extract-translations.js`, `precompile-translations.js`). An internationalization configuration package has no legitimate reason to fetch a language runtime at install time and use it to execute an obfuscated sibling bundle. Executing the payload via a freshly downloaded alternate runtime evades Node-based scanning of install hooks, and the bundle's contents are opaque and cannot be reconciled with the package's advertised purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
